title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 10

blocks.source_text: **Update**: We have now released 26.4 Snapshot 10, fixing a crash in the Multiplayer screen.
blocks.translated_text: **更新**：我们现已发布了26.4 Snapshot 10版本，修复了多人模式界面中的一个崩溃问题。

blocks.source_text: Fixed bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 10
blocks.translated_text: 修复了26.4 Snapshot 10中的漏洞。

blocks.source_text: [MC-313265](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-313265)  - The game crashes when scrolling through the multiplayer menu
blocks.translated_text: [MC-313265](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-313265) - 在浏览多人模式菜单时游戏会崩溃。

blocks.source_text: Original article:
blocks.translated_text: 原文文章：

blocks.source_text: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 9
blocks.translated_text: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 9

blocks.source_text: 26.4 Snapshot 9 is here, bringing data-driven dispensers, Vulkan as the default graphics backend, and a new setting to fine-tune your fog. We've also made improvements to keyboard navigation and narration, alongside a few other tweaks and fixes!
blocks.translated_text: 26.4 Snapshot 9现已发布，带来了数据驱动的分配器、Vulkan作为默认的图形后端，以及一个用于微调雾效的新设置。我们还改进了键盘导航和游戏旁白，并进行了其他一些调整和修复！

blocks.source_text: Happy mining!
blocks.translated_text: 快乐采矿！

blocks.source_text: Changes
blocks.translated_text: 更改内容

blocks.source_text: Added a Repeat Recipe/Trade keybind that repeats the last recipe or trade used
blocks.translated_text: 新增了“重复配方/交易”键绑定功能，可以重复使用上一次使用的配方或交易指令。

blocks.source_text: Added a separate "Improved Fog" video setting that allows to control the Improved Fog feature independently of the "Improved Transparency" video setting
blocks.translated_text: 新增了一个独立的“优化雾效”设置，允许用户独立于“优化透明度”设置来控制雾效功能

blocks.source_text: Vulkan is now the default graphics backend, rather than being randomized, and is no longer considered experimental
blocks.translated_text: Vulkan 现在已成为默认的图形后端，不再随机选择，并且不再被视为实验性技术

blocks.source_text: **Developer's Note**: *The plan is to ship 26.4 with Vulkan graphics API being the default one unless any critical issues are discovered before the full release*
blocks.translated_text: **开发者注**：计划将 Vulkan 图形 API 设为默认后端进行发布，除非在正式发布前发现任何严重问题

blocks.source_text: A Separate "Improved Fog" Video Setting
blocks.translated_text: 新增了一个独立的“优化雾效”设置

blocks.source_text: Separated the "Improved Fog" video setting from the "Improved Transparency"
blocks.translated_text: 将“优化雾效”设置与“优化透明度”设置分开

blocks.source_text: Turning it on together with the "Improved Transparency" will behave the same way as the previous Snapshot with "Improved Transparency" enabled: both sky and clouds will be blended into the terrain render distance fog
blocks.translated_text: 如果同时启用“优化雾效”和“优化透明度”，其行为将与之前的版本相同：天空和云层都会融入地形渲染的雾效中

blocks.source_text: Turning it on without "Improved Transparency" will only blend the sky but not the clouds
blocks.translated_text: 如果未启用“改进透明度”（Improved Transparency），则只会使天空颜色混合，但云层不会发生变化

blocks.source_text: You can now use "Improved Transparency" without "Improved Fog" if you don't like the effect
blocks.translated_text: 如果你不喜欢“改进雾效”（Improved Fog）的效果，现在也可以单独使用“改进透明度”

blocks.source_text: The performance impact of "Improved Fog" is minimal, but it may be noticeable on lower-end hardware
blocks.translated_text: “改进雾效”对性能的影响很小，但在低端硬件上可能会稍微明显一些

blocks.source_text: The setting is enabled by default
blocks.translated_text: 该设置默认是启用的

blocks.source_text: It is disabled on the "Fast" graphics preset and enabled on the "Fancy" and "Fabulous" graphics presets
blocks.translated_text: 在“快速”（Fast）图形预设中该效果是禁用的，而在“华丽”（Fancy）和“惊艳”（Fabulous）图形预设中则是启用的

blocks.source_text: Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities
blocks.translated_text: 对方块、物品和实体的些许调整

blocks.source_text: The random boost time for using a Carrot or Warped Fungus on a Stick while riding a Pig or Strider respectively is now between 7 and 35 seconds
blocks.translated_text: 现在在骑猪或炽足兽（Strider）时，使用“胡萝卜”或“扭曲真菌棒”（Carrot or Warped Fungus on a Stick）的随机效果持续时间在7到35秒之间

blocks.source_text: Sounds
blocks.translated_text: 音效相关调整

blocks.source_text: Fire and Soul Fire now use the extinguish sound as their block break sound, including when their supporting block is removed
blocks.translated_text: 火焰（Fire）和灵魂之火（Soul Fire）现在在摧毁自身时使用同样的熄灭音效

blocks.source_text: UI
blocks.translated_text: 用户界面（UI）

blocks.source_text: Recipe Book tabs now show their category as a tooltip
blocks.translated_text: 配方书的标签现在会以工具提示的形式显示其类别

blocks.source_text: Recipes in the Recipe Book are now highlighted when hovered or focused
blocks.translated_text: 现在当鼠标悬停或选中配方书中的配方时，这些配方会被高亮显示

blocks.source_text: Friends
blocks.translated_text: 好友系统

blocks.source_text: Improved the reliability and speed of friend availability updates
blocks.translated_text: 提高了好友状态更新的可靠性和速度

blocks.source_text: Accessibility
blocks.translated_text: 可访问性（Accessibility）

blocks.source_text: Gameplay Screen Keyboard Navigation
blocks.translated_text: 游戏玩法屏幕的键盘导航

blocks.source_text: The Recipe Book can now be used with the keyboard
blocks.translated_text: 现在可以使用键盘来操作配方书

blocks.source_text: Tab moves between the tab buttons, search box, filter button, recipes, and page buttons
blocks.translated_text: 按 Tab 键可以在标签按钮、搜索框、筛选按钮、配方列表和页面按钮之间切换

blocks.source_text: Enter/Space on a recipe places it in the crafting grid, and holding Shift places as many as possible
blocks.translated_text: 在配方上输入或按空格键会将其放入制作格中；按住 Shift 键可以一次性放入多个配方

blocks.source_text: Control + Enter on a recipe opens the popup of alternative recipes, like right-clicking
blocks.translated_text: 在配方上按下 Control + Enter 会弹出替代配方窗口，效果与右键点击相同

blocks.source_text: The arrow keys move within the popup, and Escape or Tab closes it
blocks.translated_text: 使用箭头键可以在窗口内移动；按下 Escape 或 Tab 键可以关闭窗口

blocks.source_text: Repeating the last selected recipe has moved from Space and Enter to the new Repeat Recipe/Trade key (R by default), and holding Shift still places as many as possible
blocks.translated_text: 重复上一个选中的配方的方式已从使用空格键和 Enter 键改为新的按键（默认为 R 键）；按住 Shift 键可以一次性重复尽可能多的配方

blocks.source_text: The Repeat Recipe/Trade key also repeats the last selected trade in the Villager and Wandering Trader screens
blocks.translated_text: 重复配方/交易按键也可以在村民和流浪商人界面中重复上一次的交易操作

blocks.source_text: The Creative Inventory can now be used with the keyboard
blocks.translated_text: 现在可以通过键盘操作创意库存（Creative Inventory）

blocks.source_text: Gameplay Screen Narration
blocks.translated_text: 游戏画面的旁白系统

blocks.source_text: The narrator now reads out the Recipe Book
blocks.translated_text: 旁白现在会念出配方书的名称

blocks.source_text: Recipes are narrated with their result and their column and row in the grid
blocks.translated_text: 配方会在游戏中被朗读，并同时说明其在网格中的列和行位置

blocks.source_text: The tabs, search box, and filter button are narrated with their names
blocks.translated_text: 标签页、搜索框和过滤按钮的名称也会在游戏中被朗读

blocks.source_text: The page buttons narrate the current page
blocks.translated_text: 页面上的按钮会描述当前页面的功能

blocks.source_text: Recipes in the alternative recipes popup are narrated with their position, and the narrator mentions that Escape closes it
blocks.translated_text: 替代配方弹窗中的配方会附带它们的位置信息，同时会有语音提示‘Escape’可以关闭该弹窗

blocks.source_text: The narrator now reads out the Creative Inventory
blocks.translated_text: 现在会有语音为玩家读取创意物品栏的内容

blocks.source_text: Tabs are narrated with their name and position
blocks.translated_text: 标签页会通过它们的名称和位置来进行描述

blocks.source_text: Items are narrated with their column and row in the grid
blocks.translated_text: 物品会按照它们在网格中的列和行进行命名

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: 技术性变更

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 128.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包的版本现在更新为128.0

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 104.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包的版本现在更新为104.0

blocks.source_text: Network Protocol
blocks.translated_text: 网络协议进行了修改

blocks.source_text: Modified Login Protocol
blocks.translated_text: 登录协议也经过了修改

blocks.source_text: Changed encryption key establishment procedure
blocks.translated_text: 修改了加密密钥的生成流程

blocks.source_text: Dedicated Server Properties
blocks.translated_text: 专用服务器属性

blocks.source_text: Added key-rotation-period-seconds field
blocks.translated_text: 添加了‘key-rotation-period-seconds’字段

blocks.source_text: Determines the minimum duration after which server keys (used for establishing new connections) will be recreated
blocks.translated_text: 用于指定服务器密钥（用于建立新连接）在被重新生成之前的最小持续时间

blocks.source_text: If set to 0 a unique (i.e. ephemeral) key will be used for every connection
blocks.translated_text: 如果设置为0，则每次连接都会使用一个唯一的（即临时的）密钥

blocks.source_text: Default value: 60
blocks.translated_text: 默认值：60

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Versions 122.0 through 128.0
Dispense behaviors are now data-driven
blocks.translated_text: 现在分配行为是由数据驱动的

blocks.source_text: Commands
blocks.translated_text: 命令

blocks.source_text: Added support for local arguments in 2D coordinates
blocks.translated_text: 增加了对2D坐标中本地参数的支持

blocks.source_text: Arguments in form of ^<left> ^<forwards> are now accepted in commands that take 2D coordinates:
blocks.translated_text: 现在，接受以 ^<left> ^<forwards> 形式给出的参数，这些参数用于需要二维坐标的命令中。

blocks.source_text: Chunk coordinates in forceload
blocks.translated_text: 强制加载（forceload）中的区块坐标

blocks.source_text: spreadplayers <center>
blocks.translated_text: spreadplayers <center>

blocks.source_text: worldborder center <pos>
blocks.translated_text: 世界边界中心 <pos>

blocks.source_text: Only takes into account player rotation around Y axis (as opposed to interpreting that as ^<left> ^0 ^<forwards> and casting to XZ plane)
blocks.translated_text: 仅考虑玩家围绕 Y 轴的旋转（而不是将其解释为 ^<left> ^0 ^<forwards> 并转换到 XZ 平面）

blocks.source_text: Dispense Behaviors
blocks.translated_text: 分配物品行为（Dispense Behaviors）

blocks.source_text: A new registry folder: dispense_behavior. Each file is a list of behaviors that describe a sequence of behaviors to attempt when dispensing an item. Unless otherwise noted, behaviors are tried in sequence until one succeeds.
blocks.translated_text: 新增了一个注册表文件夹：dispense_behavior。每个文件都包含一系列行为描述，用于在分配物品时尝试执行这些行为。除非另有说明，否则会按顺序尝试这些行为，直到其中一种成功。

blocks.source_text: Each entry has a type field specifying a dispense behavior type as described below, possibly with type-specific additional fields.
blocks.translated_text: 每个条目都有一个类型字段，用于指定分配行为类型（如下所述），可能还包含特定类型的附加字段。

Original article:

Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 9

26.4 Snapshot 9 is here, bringing data-driven dispensers, Vulkan as the default graphics backend, and a new setting to fine-tune your fog. We've also made improvements to keyboard navigation and narration, alongside a few other tweaks and fixes!

Happy mining!

Changes

Added a Repeat Recipe/Trade keybind that repeats the last recipe or trade used

Added a separate "Improved Fog" video setting that allows to control the Improved Fog feature independently of the "Improved Transparency" video setting

Vulkan is now the default graphics backend, rather than being randomized, and is no longer considered experimental

**Developer's Note**: *The plan is to ship 26.4 with Vulkan graphics API being the default one unless any critical issues are discovered before the full release*

A Separate "Improved Fog" Video Setting

Separated the "Improved Fog" video setting from the "Improved Transparency"

Turning it on together with the "Improved Transparency" will behave the same way as the previous Snapshot with "Improved Transparency" enabled: both sky and clouds will be blended into the terrain render distance fog

Turning it on without "Improved Transparency" will only blend the sky but not the clouds

You can now use "Improved Transparency" without "Improved Fog" if you don't like the effect

The performance impact of "Improved Fog" is minimal, but it may be noticeable on lower-end hardware

The setting is enabled by default

It is disabled on the "Fast" graphics preset and enabled on the "Fancy" and "Fabulous" graphics presets

Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

The random boost time for using a Carrot or Warped Fungus on a Stick while riding a Pig or Strider respectively is now between 7 and 35 seconds

Sounds

Fire and Soul Fire now use the extinguish sound as their block break sound, including when their supporting block is removed

UI

Recipe Book tabs now show their category as a tooltip

Recipes in the Recipe Book are now highlighted when hovered or focused

Friends

Improved the reliability and speed of friend availability updates

Accessibility

Gameplay Screen Keyboard Navigation

The Recipe Book can now be used with the keyboard

Tab moves between the tab buttons, search box, filter button, recipes, and page buttons

Enter/Space on a recipe places it in the crafting grid, and holding Shift places as many as possible

Control + Enter on a recipe opens the popup of alternative recipes, like right-clicking

The arrow keys move within the popup, and Escape or Tab closes it

Repeating the last selected recipe has moved from Space and Enter to the new Repeat Recipe/Trade key (R by default), and holding Shift still places as many as possible

The Repeat Recipe/Trade key also repeats the last selected trade in the Villager and Wandering Trader screens

The Creative Inventory can now be used with the keyboard

Gameplay Screen Narration

The narrator now reads out the Recipe Book

Recipes are narrated with their result and their column and row in the grid

The tabs, search box, and filter button are narrated with their names

The page buttons narrate the current page

Recipes in the alternative recipes popup are narrated with their position, and the narrator mentions that Escape closes it

The narrator now reads out the Creative Inventory

Tabs are narrated with their name and position

Items are narrated with their column and row in the grid

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 128.0

The Resource Pack version is now 104.0

Network Protocol

Modified Login Protocol

Changed encryption key establishment procedure

Dedicated Server Properties

Added key-rotation-period-seconds field

Determines the minimum duration after which server keys (used for establishing new connections) will be recreated

If set to 0 a unique (i.e. ephemeral) key will be used for every connection

Default value: 60

Data Pack Versions 122.0 through 128.0

Dispense behaviors are now data-driven

Commands

Added support for local arguments in 2D coordinates

Arguments in form of ^<left> ^<forwards> are now accepted in commands that take 2D coordinates:

Chunk coordinates in forceload

spreadplayers <center>

worldborder center <pos>

Only takes into account player rotation around Y axis (as opposed to interpreting that as ^<left> ^0 ^<forwards> and casting to XZ plane)

Dispense Behaviors

A new registry folder: dispense_behavior. Each file is a list of behaviors that describe a sequence of behaviors to attempt when dispensing an item. Unless otherwise noted, behaviors are tried in sequence until one succeeds.

Each entry has a type field specifying a dispense behavior type as described below, possibly with type-specific additional fields.

Vanilla entries:

minecraft:armor_stand - Used for Armor Stands

minecraft:boat - Used for all types of Boats, Chest Boats, Rafts and Chest Rafts

minecraft:bone_meal - Used for Bone Meal

minecraft:brush - Used for Brushes

minecraft:carved_pumpkin - Used for Carved Pumpkins

minecraft:chest - Used for Chests (note: only default Chests, not Trapped, Copper or other types of Chests)

minecraft:default - Used for any items without another specified behavior

minecraft:default_projectile - Used for all types of Arrows, all types of Eggs, Snow Balls and Ice Balls

minecraft:dropper - Used for all item types by Droppers

minecraft:empty_bucket - Used for empty Buckets

minecraft:equipment - Used for all types of equippables except Carved Pumpkins and Wither Skeleton Skulls

minecraft:filled_bucket - Used for all types of Buckets with any contents

minecraft:fire_charge - Used for Fire Charges

minecraft:firework_rocket - Used for all Firework Rockets

minecraft:flint_and_steel - Used for Flint & Steel

minecraft:glass_bottle - Used for empty Glass Bottles

minecraft:glowstone - Used for Glowstone Blocks

minecraft:honeycomb - Used for Honeycombs

minecraft:minecart - Used for all types of Minecarts

minecraft:potion - Used for Potions (note: only default Potions, not Splash or Lingering)

minecraft:shears - Used for Shears

minecraft:shulker_box - Used for all Shulker Boxes

minecraft:spawn_egg - Used for all Spawn Eggs

minecraft:thrown_potion - Used for Splash Potions and Lingering Potions

minecraft:tnt - Used for TNT Blocks

minecraft:wind_charge - Used for Wind Charges

minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull - Used for Wither Skeleton Skulls

Dispense Behavior Types

minecraft:brush_armadillo

Brushes an Armadillo in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

minecraft:charge_respawn_anchor

Charges a Respawn Anchor in front of the Dispenser

If the Respawn Anchor is already fully charged, no further behaviors are tried

No additional fields

minecraft:convert_to_mud

Converts the block in front of the Dispenser to Mud in case it has the #minecraft:convertible_to_mud block tag.

The item needs to contain a Water potion, otherwise it fails

No additional fields

minecraft:drop_item

The item is dropped as an item entity

No additional fields

minecraft:empty_bucket

Empties the bucket in front of the Dispenser

The item needs to be a bucket, otherwise it fails

No additional fields

minecraft:equip

Equips the item onto a living entity in front of the Dispenser

The item must be equippable onto a slot of the entity

No additional fields

minecraft:equip_chest

Equips a Chest onto a tamed mob that can carry a Chest in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

minecraft:equip_sulfur_cube

Gives the item to a Sulfur Cube in front of the Dispenser

The item needs to be in the #minecraft:sulfur_cube_swallowable item tag, otherwise it fails

No additional fields

minecraft:fill_bottle

Fills the bottle from the block in front

No additional fields

minecraft:fill_bucket

Picks up a fluid in front of the Dispenser, filling the bucket

No additional fields

minecraft:grow_plant

Grows a plant in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

minecraft:ignite

Ignites the block in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

minecraft:insert_into_container

Inserts the item into a container in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

minecraft:place_armor_stand

Places an Armor Stand in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

minecraft:place_block

Places the item as a block in front of the Dispenser

The item needs to be a block item, otherwise it fails

No additional fields

minecraft:place_boat

Places a Boat on water in front of the Dispenser

The entity type is determined by the minecraft:entity_data component of the item, and needs to be a Boat, Chest Boat, Raft or Chest Raft

For any other entity type, the action fails

No additional fields

minecraft:place_minecart

Places a Minecart on rails in front of the Dispenser

The entity type is determined by the minecraft:entity_data component of the item, and needs to be a Minecart

For any other entity type, the action fails

No additional fields

minecraft:shear

Shears a mob or harvests a beehive in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

minecraft:shoot_projectile

Shoots the item as a projectile

The item needs to be a projectile item, such as an Arrow or Snowball

Additional fields:

offset - vector of 3 doubles, the offset of the spawn position of the projectile from the center of the Dispenser

scale - double, how far from the offset position to spawn the projectile, along the direction of the Dispenser

uncertainty - non-negative float, the inaccuracy of the shot

power - non-negative float, the velocity of the shot

sound - optional object, the sound to play when shooting (defaults to minecraft:block.dispenser.launch with volume 1.0 and pitch 1.2 )

sound - Sound Event to play

volume - float provider, the volume of the sound

pitch - float provider, the pitch of the sound

minecraft:spawn_golem_from_carved_pumpkin

Completes a Golem in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

minecraft:spawn_mob

Spawns the entity defined by the minecraft:entity_data component in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

minecraft:spawn_tnt

Spawns Primed TNT in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

minecraft:transform_block

Transforms the block in front of the Dispenser using a Block Transformer

Additional field:

transformer - Namespaced ID of the Block Transformer to use

minecraft:spawn_wither_from_wither_skeleton_skull

Completes a Wither in front of the Dispenser

No additional fields

Data Components

Added minecraft:dispense_behavior

Determines what happens when the item is dispensed from a Dispenser.

Format: Namespaced ID of a dispense_behavior registry entry or an inline list of Dispense Behaviors

minecraft:entity_data

Boat and Minecart items now have this component by default, determining which entity is placed when the item is used or dispensed

Entity types that do not match the type requirement result in the action failing

Block Transformers

Added block transformer minecraft:honeycomb

Used to wax blocks (currently only from dispensers)

Particles

Changed minecraft:current_down

Added new field radius - float, the radius around the position to spawn the particle at

Changed minecraft:bubble_column_up

Added optional field pop_chance - float between 0.0 and 1.0, the chance that the particle will spawn a pop particle and play a pop sound once at the end of its lifecycle

If omitted, defaults to 0.0

Dialogs

The game will now show red text and a warning tooltip if the user appears to be entering an email address into a dialog input field

Resource Pack Versions 98.0 through 104.0

Certain language keys can no longer be replaced by resource packs:

All keys beginning with menu.custom_options

All keys beginning with menu.custom_screen_info

UI Sprites

Added new UI textures:

recipe_book/slot_highlight_back.png

recipe_book/slot_highlight_front.png

Shaders & Post-process Effects

core/terrain.fsh was modified to support the separate "Improved Fog" video setting

**更新**：我们现已发布了26.4 Snapshot 10版本，修复了多人模式界面中的一个崩溃问题。

原文文章：

Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 9

26.4 Snapshot 9现已发布，带来了数据驱动的分配器、Vulkan作为默认的图形后端，以及一个用于微调雾效的新设置。我们还改进了键盘导航和游戏旁白，并进行了其他一些调整和修复！

快乐采矿！

更改内容

新增了“重复配方/交易”键绑定功能，可以重复使用上一次使用的配方或交易指令。

新增了一个独立的“优化雾效”设置，允许用户独立于“优化透明度”设置来控制雾效功能

Vulkan 现在已成为默认的图形后端，不再随机选择，并且不再被视为实验性技术

**开发者注**：计划将 Vulkan 图形 API 设为默认后端进行发布，除非在正式发布前发现任何严重问题

新增了一个独立的“优化雾效”设置

将“优化雾效”设置与“优化透明度”设置分开

如果同时启用“优化雾效”和“优化透明度”，其行为将与之前的版本相同：天空和云层都会融入地形渲染的雾效中

如果未启用“改进透明度”（Improved Transparency），则只会使天空颜色混合，但云层不会发生变化

如果你不喜欢“改进雾效”（Improved Fog）的效果，现在也可以单独使用“改进透明度”

“改进雾效”对性能的影响很小，但在低端硬件上可能会稍微明显一些

该设置默认是启用的

在“快速”（Fast）图形预设中该效果是禁用的，而在“华丽”（Fancy）和“惊艳”（Fabulous）图形预设中则是启用的

对方块、物品和实体的些许调整

现在在骑猪或炽足兽（Strider）时，使用“胡萝卜”或“扭曲真菌棒”（Carrot or Warped Fungus on a Stick）的随机效果持续时间在7到35秒之间

音效相关调整

火焰（Fire）和灵魂之火（Soul Fire）现在在摧毁自身时使用同样的熄灭音效

用户界面（UI）

配方书的标签现在会以工具提示的形式显示其类别

现在当鼠标悬停或选中配方书中的配方时，这些配方会被高亮显示

好友系统

提高了好友状态更新的可靠性和速度

可访问性（Accessibility）

游戏玩法屏幕的键盘导航

现在可以使用键盘来操作配方书

按 Tab 键可以在标签按钮、搜索框、筛选按钮、配方列表和页面按钮之间切换

在配方上输入或按空格键会将其放入制作格中；按住 Shift 键可以一次性放入多个配方

在配方上按下 Control + Enter 会弹出替代配方窗口，效果与右键点击相同

使用箭头键可以在窗口内移动；按下 Escape 或 Tab 键可以关闭窗口

重复上一个选中的配方的方式已从使用空格键和 Enter 键改为新的按键（默认为 R 键）；按住 Shift 键可以一次性重复尽可能多的配方

重复配方/交易按键也可以在村民和流浪商人界面中重复上一次的交易操作

现在可以通过键盘操作创意库存（Creative Inventory）

游戏画面的旁白系统

旁白现在会念出配方书的名称

配方会在游戏中被朗读，并同时说明其在网格中的列和行位置

标签页、搜索框和过滤按钮的名称也会在游戏中被朗读

页面上的按钮会描述当前页面的功能

替代配方弹窗中的配方会附带它们的位置信息，同时会有语音提示‘Escape’可以关闭该弹窗

现在会有语音为玩家读取创意物品栏的内容

标签页会通过它们的名称和位置来进行描述

物品会按照它们在网格中的列和行进行命名

技术性变更

数据包的版本现在更新为128.0

资源包的版本现在更新为104.0

网络协议进行了修改

登录协议也经过了修改

修改了加密密钥的生成流程

专用服务器属性

添加了‘key-rotation-period-seconds’字段

用于指定服务器密钥（用于建立新连接）在被重新生成之前的最小持续时间

如果设置为0，则每次连接都会使用一个唯一的（即临时的）密钥

默认值：60

数据包版本122.0至128.0

现在分配行为是由数据驱动的

命令

增加了对2D坐标中本地参数的支持

现在，接受以 ^<left> ^<forwards> 形式给出的参数，这些参数用于需要二维坐标的命令中。

强制加载（forceload）中的区块坐标

spreadplayers <center>

世界边界中心 <pos>

仅考虑玩家围绕 Y 轴的旋转（而不是将其解释为 ^<left> ^0 ^<forwards> 并转换到 XZ 平面）

分配物品行为（Dispense Behaviors）

新增了一个注册表文件夹：dispense_behavior。每个文件都包含一系列行为描述，用于在分配物品时尝试执行这些行为。除非另有说明，否则会按顺序尝试这些行为，直到其中一种成功。

每个条目都有一个类型字段，用于指定分配行为类型（如下所述），可能还包含特定类型的附加字段。
